title: Lookup failure messages embed the raw applicant phone number (PII) into Sentry
evidence:
capture_failure(
                sentry,
                message: "Twilio Lookup HTTP "
                  <> int.to_string(status)
                  <> " for phone "
                  <> phone,
                tags: [#("http_status", int.to_string(status))],
              )
--- AC5 (same diff) ---
then Sentry captures it with context (status / error kind / endpoint tags)
detail: The raw phone (applicant PII) is written into the Sentry message on every lookup failure, exceeding AC5's stated context (status/error-kind/endpoint tags). For a GDPR-heavy app this sends PII to a third-party sink.
recommended_fix: Log only a redacted phone (e.g. last 4 digits) in the Sentry message; keep the full number in local logs only.
